0022600148.text: The Charlotte Hornets, now 3-3 and 2-1 at home, host the Philadelphia 76ers in their seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Charlotte 8th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast after losing their last two. Philadelphia comes in 5-1 on a two-game winning streak, first in the Atlantic and 2-0 on the road, and the Hornets lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 118-114 defeat in Charlotte on March 28. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Jaylen Brown (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
